contentEn:
A whole house renovation in Richmond, BC typically takes 4 to 8 months for a mid-range whole-home update, and 8 to 18 months for a full gut renovation with structural changes, new additions, or secondary suite creation. The exact timeline depends on project scope, permit complexity, and whether your property requires strata approval.

聚星装修 has completed whole house renovations across Richmond neighbourhoods including Steveston, Ironwood, Gilmore, and the West Richmond residential areas. Every project below reflects a real 2025–2026 Richmond renovation with verified timelines.

Real Richmond Whole House Renovation Timelines (2026)

These are actual timelines from completed Richmond projects, not estimates:

What Drives the Timeline in Richmond

1. Permits and the City of Richmond

The City of Richmond requires permits for any structural change, electrical upgrades, plumbing relocation, and secondary suite creation. Permit review times in Richmond typically run 2 to 4 weeks for routine renovations. Projects involving additions, secondary suites, or fire-alarm upgrades can take 6 to 10 weeks for permit issuance.

2. Strata Approval for Townhouses and Condos

Approximately 60% of Richmond's housing stock is strata-titled — townhouses in areas like Brighouse, Highgate, and Guildford, and condos throughout the city. Strata approval adds 3 to 8 weeks before you can pull a building permit. The Strata Property Act requires a 50% vote (or as specified in your bylaws) for renovations affecting common property or exterior alterations.

3. Flood Zone Considerations

Richmond sits within the Fraser River floodplain and the City has elevation requirements for new construction and additions. Renovations that involve lowering floor levels, creating new basements, or significant foundation work require a flood construction level (FCL) assessment. This adds 1 to 2 weeks to permitting.

4. ALR Properties

Some Richmond properties near No. 6 Road and the agricultural land reserve have additional restrictions. If your project is on or adjacent to ALR land, an Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) application may be required before the City issues a permit. This can add 8 to 16 weeks to a project timeline.

How to Keep Your Richmond Renovation on Schedule

  • Start strata approval early. If your property is strata-titled, submit your application in parallel with permit design work. Strata approval can run 3 to 8 weeks and cannot be rushed — start this process first.
  • Make material selections before demo. Cabinet lead times in Richmond run 4 to 8 weeks for semi-custom and 8 to 14 weeks for custom cabinetry. Order these the day permits are issued.
  • Confirm FCL requirements before design finalizes. If you plan to lower a basement floor or create a new below-grade space, get a flood construction level assessment before signing off on the design. Changing scope mid-construction adds 4 to 8 weeks.
  • Book inspections as soon as stages complete. Richmond building inspectors schedule 3 to 5 days out. Call the City of Richmond building department the morning each stage finishes to get on the schedule.
  • Use a contractor with Richmond experience. Richmond's combination of floodplain regulations, strata processes, and ALR proximity means a contractor familiar with local bylaw requirements avoids costly redesign mid-project.

Frequently Asked Questions — Richmond Whole House Renovation Timeline

How long does a whole house renovation take in Richmond, BC?

A mid-range whole house renovation in Richmond — kitchen, 1 to 2 bathrooms, and flooring — takes 10 to 14 weeks with strata approval, or 10 to 14 weeks without. A full gut renovation with structural changes, additions, or secondary suite creation takes 16 to 22 weeks. The main variables are whether your property is strata-titled and whether flood construction level requirements apply to your project.

Does a townhouse renovation in Richmond require strata approval?

Yes, if your renovation affects common property, exterior walls, or anything that impacts other owners in the strata corporation. Interior renovations that do not alter common property — flooring replacement, kitchen renovation within existing cabinet footprint, bathroom renovation — typically do not require strata approval. Confirm your specific scope with your strata manager before starting. 聚星装修 handles the strata approval process as part of our contract.

How long does it take to get a building permit in Richmond?

The City of Richmond typically issues building permits for routine renovations within 2 to 4 weeks of application. Complex permits involving structural changes, secondary suites, or additions take 4 to 10 weeks. Permit applications in Richmond for properties within the floodplain require a flood construction level assessment, which adds 1 to 2 weeks. Factor in an additional 3 to 8 weeks for strata approval if your property is strata-titled.

Does Richmond have any special rules that affect renovation timelines?

Richmond has three factors that extend timelines compared to other Metro Vancouver cities: floodplain flood construction level (FCL) requirements for below-grade work, a high proportion of strata-titled properties requiring pre-approval, and agricultural land reserve (ALR) proximity for properties near the city's eastern edge. These rules are manageable with proper pre-planning — our team accounts for all three in every Richmond project scope.

What is the biggest cause of delays in Richmond renovations?

Material lead times — particularly for cabinets, quartz countertops, and custom millwork — are the most common source of delays. Cabinet lead times from Richmond's nearest suppliers run 4 to 8 weeks for semi-custom and 8 to 14 weeks for fully custom. 聚星装修 orders all materials the day permits are issued and manages supplier logistics to keep construction on schedule.

影响列治文工期的关键因素

1. 许可证与列治文市

列治文市（City of Richmond）对所有结构改动、电路升级、水管重铺和套房改造均要求许可。常规翻新项目的许可证审查时间通常为 2 至 4 周。涉及加建、套房改造或消防系统升级的项目，许可证核发可能需要 6 至 10 周。

2. 联排别墅和公寓的 Strata 审批

列治文约 60% 的住宅为 strata 产权性质——Brighouse、Highgate、Guildford 等区域的联排别墅，以及全市范围内的公寓。Strata 审批需要在申请建筑许可证之前完成，额外增加 3 至 8 周。根据《Strata Property Act》，翻新工程如涉及公共区域或外观改动，需获得 50% 投票（或按 bylaws 规定）。

3. 洪泛区因素

列治文位于菲沙河冲积平原，市政府对新建和加建有海拔要求。涉及降低楼层、新建地下室或重大地基工程的项目，需要进行洪水建造水位（FCL）评估。这会使许可审批增加 1 至 2 周。

4. 农业储备用地（ALR）

列治文部分物业（主要在 6号路沿线及周边农业用地保护区）有额外限制。如物业在 ALR 用地或相邻区域，工程需先向农业土地委员会（ALC）提交申请。这可能额外增加 8 至 16 周 审批时间。

厨房 + 浴室 + 地板（列治文最常见范围）

这是列治文最常见的整屋装修范围——更新厨房、翻新 1 至 2 间浴室、更换全屋地板。此范围通常不需要结构许可。

如何确保列治文装修按时完成

  • 尽早启动 strata 审批。 如果您的物业为 strata 产权，请与许可证设计并行提交申请。Strata 审批需 3 至 8 周，无法加速——请最先启动此流程。
  • 拆除前敲定材料。 列治文附近的橱柜交货期， 半定制 4 至 8 周， 全定制 8 至 14 周。许可证核发当日立即下单。
  • 设计定稿前确认 FCL 要求。 如计划降低地下室楼层或新建地下空间，请在设计定稿前完成洪水建造水位评估。施工中途改变范围将增加 4 至 8 周。
  • 每个阶段完工立即预约验收。 列治文建筑检查员排期通常提前 3 至 5 天。每个阶段完工当天上午致电市政府建筑部门预约。
  • 选择有列治文经验的承包商。 列治文特有的洪泛区法规、strata 流程和 ALR 相邻物业组合，意味着熟悉本地要求的承包商可避免施工中途重新设计。

常见问题 — 列治文整屋装修工期

列治文整屋装修通常需要多长时间？

列治文中档整屋装修——厨房、1 至 2 间浴室和地板——有 strata 审批的情况下通常需要 10 至 14 周，无 strata 审批则为 10 至 14 周。涉及结构改动、加建或套房改造的全面拆旧翻新，通常需要 16 至 22 周。主要变量在于物业是否为 strata 产权，以及项目是否涉及洪水建造水位要求。

列治文联排别墅翻新需要 strata 审批吗？

如果翻新工程涉及公共区域、外墙或影响其他 strata 业主的改动，则需要审批。不改变公共区域的内部翻新——地板更换、橱柜范围内厨房翻新、浴室翻新——通常不需要 strata 审批。开工前请与 strata 物业经理确认您的具体工程范围。聚星装修（聚星装修）会在合同中包含 strata 审批流程办理。

列治文建筑许可证需要多长时间？

列治文市通常在申请后 2 至 4 周内核发常规翻新建筑许可证。涉及结构改动、套房或加建的复杂许可证需要 4 至 10 周。位于洪泛区的物业申请，还需进行洪水建造水位评估，额外增加 1 至 2 周。此外，strata 产权物业在申请前还需额外 3 至 8 周 进行 strata 审批。

列治文有什么特殊规定会影响装修工期？

列治文有三个因素会导致工期比其他大温城市更长：地下工程的洪水建造水位（FCL）要求、占比较高的 strata 产权物业（需提前审批），以及城市东部边缘物业的农业土地保护区（ALR）相邻问题。这些规定通过充分的前期规划完全可以管理——我们的团队在每个列治文项目启动前都会将这些因素纳入考量。

列治文装修延误的最常见原因是什么？

材料交货期——尤其是橱柜、石英石台面和定制木制品——是最常见的延误来源。列治文最近供应商的橱柜交货期，半定制 4 至 8 周，全定制 8 至 14 周。聚星装修（聚星装修）在许可证核发当日即开始订购所有材料，并管理供应商物流，确保施工按计划推进。
